label: early original-phase input of c/t/j/z
explanation: Fires mainly during the original-input phase (94% of mass) when the input token is one of c, t, j, z (about 30% firing rate each, 6x lift; together 81% of mass), with c strongest. Firing is more likely early in the sequence (t 0-4) and drops off after that; it is weaker when other c/t/j/z tokens or repeats appeared earlier (in_first=1 carries 92% of mass). A weaker secondary response shows on k (2x lift) and on the step right after k (top examples are often k followed by c/z). It is mostly silent in the copy phase (0.7% rate) and on the delimiter (2.4%). Only about 30% of c/t/j/z inputs fire, so precision is limited; the leftover variation seems to come from graded hidden-state context that no simple predicate captures (dev F1 about 0.65, mass recall 0.72).
